headline: Stephon Gilmore, '19 NFL DPOY, retiring as member of the Patriots
summary: Stephon Gilmore, a two-time All-Pro cornerback and the NFL's 2019 Defensive Player of the Year, is signing a one-day contract in New England to retire as a member of the Patriots,

headline: QB Burrow good to go, DE Stewart set for Bengals debut vs. Texans
summary: Bengals QB Joe Burrow (back) was a full participant at Friday's practice and is set to start in Sunday's road affair against the Texans.

headline: Mired in historic interception drought, Jets rule out Fitzpatrick
summary: The Jets, mired in the longest interception drought in NFL history, will be without their most accomplished interceptor Sunday against the Packers as former All-Pro safety Minkah Fitzpatrick was ruled out with a groin injury.

headline: Bills WR D.J. Moore Day-To-Day With AC Joint Sprain
summary: Bills wide receiver D.J. Moore left Thursday night’s win over the Lions before halftime and did not return with the team announcing a shoulder injury as the cause. headline: With Penix not ready, Rush getting second start for Falcons
summary: The Falcons will start quarterback Cooper Rush for the second straight week, coach Kevin Stefanski said Friday.

headline: Jack Campbell fights back tears in explaining Lions loss to Bills
summary: The Bills shredded the Lions on Thursday night for 41 points and 446 yards.
